_meta.purpose: PartSmith effect-card data for Ironclad. Effects identical to vanilla StS2 Ironclad cards.
_meta.generatedFor: another AI to import into the mod (generate EffectCardModelBase subclasses + cards.json localization)
implementationTips: Generate one EffectCardModelBase subclass per card. Constructor: base(0, CardType.X, CardRarity.Y, TargetType.Z) — effect cards cost 0 energy (never played alone).
ExecuteEffect: port onPlayCode logic, replacing 'this'/'base.Owner'/'base.DynamicVars' with the HOST spliced card — use cardPlay.Card as the attack/power source (see existing StrikeFragment).
Keywords (Exhaust/Ethereal/Innate/Retain/Unplayable) come from the 'keywords' field; the mod must also transfer them onto the host card when splicing (in SpliceController.AttachEffect).
Rarity field drives reward spawn weights — keep as-is.

CARD ART: the spliced (host) card's PortraitPath is already overridden in CostCardModelBase to return the FIRST attached effect card's PortraitPath. Effect cards themselves have no art yet (fall back to placeholder), so give each effect card art by reusing the matching VANILLA card's portrait — override PortraitPath/BetaPortraitPath, e.g. `public override string PortraitPath => ModelDb.Card<Uppercut>().PortraitPath;` (resolves to atlases/card_atlas.sprites/ironclad/uppercut.tres, exists in game assets). 'portraitFrom' field lists the vanilla CardModel type to reference. Then the spliced card automatically shows the vanilla Ironclad art.
Localization: cards.json (eng): {id}.title = title, {id}.description = description. Chinese: use titleZh for {id}.title and descriptionZh for {id}.description.
